digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria registry and reviewer prompts
propositions: Dual vocabulary 'Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts causes the LLM to treat them as one pooled criterion rather than distinct concepts, introducing noise in rubrics.
The criteria guide is generated from reviewer prompts and criteria routing index; renaming Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria at the source requires regenerating the guide to propagate changes.

Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding plan-review attestations; this is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) merges to grandfather those attestations.

Three sites explicitly excluded from renaming: plan_review_T2.md (success metrics for pilot trials is generic English), and dod_uncertifiable wording in plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (separate definition-of-done concept).
